segments.text: Giant pandas spend up to 14 hours a day eating.
segments.englishExplanation: Giant pandas spend up to 14 hours every day eating.
segments.turkishExplanation: Dev pandalar günde 14 saate kadar olan zamanı yemek yiyerek geçirir.

segments.text: That sounds like a lot of fun, but there is a reason behind it.
segments.englishExplanation: That might sound fun, but there is a specific reason for this behavior.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bu kulağa çok eğlenceli gibi geliyor ama bunun arkasında bir neden var.

segments.text: Because bamboo is low in nutritional value, it does not give pandas much energy to move
segments.englishExplanation: Since bamboo lacks high nutritional value, it fails to provide pandas with enough energy to move.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bambunun besin değeri düşük olduğundan, pandalara hareket etmeleri için fazla enerji vermez

segments.text: around for longer periods of time.
segments.englishExplanation: ...moving around for extended periods of time.

segments.text: So they eat huge amounts of it, rest a lot, and avoid climbing when they don't need to.
segments.englishExplanation: Therefore, they eat large quantities of bamboo, rest frequently, and avoid unnecessary climbing.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bu yüzden bol miktarda bambu yerler, çok dinlenirler ve mecbur kalmadıkça tırmanmaktan kaçınırlar.

segments.englishExplanation: Living at a slow pace is not a sign of laziness.
segments.turkishExplanation: Onların bu yavaş yaşamı bir tembellik değildir.

segments.text: It's a clever way of saving energy.
segments.englishExplanation: It is a smart strategy to conserve their energy.
segments.turkishExplanation: Enerji tasarrufu yapmanın akıllıca bir yoludur.

segments.text: If they ate more meat, like their bare cousins,
segments.englishExplanation: If their diet included more meat like other bear species,
segments.turkishExplanation: Diğer ayı kuzenleri gibi daha fazla et yeselerdi,

segments.text: they would probably be far more active.
segments.englishExplanation: ...they would likely be significantly more active.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: The second conditional is used to express hypothetical or unreal situations in the present or future.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Gerçekleşmesi muhtemel olmayan veya varsayımsal durumları ifade etmek için second conditional yapısı kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: If they ate more meat, they would have more energy.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Daha fazla et yeselerdi daha fazla enerjileri olurdu.

quiz.question: ______ bamboo is low in nutritional value, it does not give pandas much energy to move around for longer periods of time.
